rows.text:
GCC
Menu
THE BREAKAWAY · AN ALTERNATE 2008
THE OLD ORDER IS BREAKING.

Saudi investors have put a new global T20 league on the table. The money is there. Now they need clubs willing to leave their domestic competitions and players willing to follow.

Eight clubs from India, Australia and England accept the offer. They keep their names, colours and home grounds, but their next title will be fought for in Global Champions Cricket.

The cricket world is divided. Some players commit to the breakaway; others stay with the established leagues. Over five days, the signing window decides who is available. Then a snake draft builds eight squads of fifteen.

You take over one of those clubs. Build the squad, name the eleven and play fourteen matches before the top four contest the title. From the first draft in 2008 to the final season in 2026, the club’s story is yours.

HAM
SOUTHAMPTON · ENGLAND · VITALITY BLAST

Hampshire offers a home for disciplined cricket. Seam assistance and slightly larger pockets let a well-organised side build pressure over several overs.

HOME GROUND
The Rose Bowl
Control and seam

There is enough seam to reward a disciplined attack without making batting impossible. With slightly larger pockets, control and good field placement can keep pressure building.

Pace & carry
Some help
Spin & grip
Slight grip
Boundaries
Harder to clear
BUILD YOUR SIDE
Use the new ball.
1
New-ball pace

Make the extra carry count with strong new-ball bowling.

2
A resilient top order

Look for strong powerplay batting to negotiate the opening spell.

3
Protect the bigger pockets

Strong fielding and running help you make the most of a harder-to-clear ground.

Kolkata Knight Riders

KKR
KOLKATA · INDIA · IPL

Kolkata offers a meeting of spin and strokeplay. Build a side that can absorb pressure, then change the pace of an innings.

HOME GROUND
Eden Gardens
Spin and strokeplay

Spin stays involved, but batters who settle can still score by using the pace available and working the field. Momentum can shift quickly once someone gets in.

Pace & carry
Little help
Spin & grip
Strong grip
Boundaries
Balanced
BUILD YOUR SIDE
Lean into spin.
1
Middle-overs spin

Use the grip with a specialist spinner and strong middle bowling.

2
Keep the middle moving

Look for strong middle batting to avoid getting tied down by spin.

3
A strong fielding unit

Back your attack with good fielding to limit runs between boundaries.
